title: 第529章 千万......别待太长时间
slug: 规则怪谈从诡异哆啦a梦开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

考拉国天幕。

考拉国天选者芮娜娜，已到达了羊村。

虽然前期抄了龙国的作业，但和林远不同，她并没有和沸羊羊一起等待暖羊羊。

到达羊村后，芮娜娜便拜访了懒羊羊。

原本她想昨天懒羊羊救了她，今天怎么也会说点关于本次怪谈游戏注意事项。

哪知到了懒羊羊家里，后者一点也不待见她。

“灰太狼大叔，你来我家有什么事吗？”

懒羊羊的语气，平淡的就像在他们国家路边看到袋鼠一般。

芮娜娜整理了一下语气，将遇到沸羊羊的事情全盘托出。

懒羊羊听完之后，伸了个懒腰。

“灰太狼大叔，你是想问问我，这么抓回去会不会有问题吧？”

芮娜娜没想到，懒羊羊居然如此聪慧。

今天的提示机会已经用完了，借鉴三次选择也在午夜羊圈用了。

所以......她唯一能想到的，就是像林远一般与诡异拉近距离。

其实如果可以，她是打算去问问红太狼的。

只是那个时候沸羊羊催的紧，她没有时间。

退而其次，就只好是找懒羊羊了。

芮娜娜点了点头：

“是啊，懒羊羊，我总觉得那样有问题。”

“你说让他们面对面泡澡，美羊羊会不会......”

芮娜娜突然想到，懒羊羊他们似乎并不知道自己能诡异化。

未曾想，懒羊羊直接说道：

“你是说，如果让美羊羊察觉的话，会不会杀了你们？”

芮娜娜摊手：

“好吧，我就是这个意思。”

懒羊羊脸上的慵懒渐渐褪去，脸上露出了一抹微笑：

“灰太狼大叔了，你怎么还害怕我们小羊的报复呀，昨天的你......可不是这样的。”

芮娜娜表情有些僵滞，但很快便恢复了正常。

“哎呦，懒羊羊，我是逗你的啦。”

“我都不怕沸羊羊，还能怕美羊羊？”

“况且......都到我家里了，我还能让他们跑了？”

懒羊羊疑惑的看着芮娜娜，心中摇摆不定。

“我来你家里呢，是想让你帮我看看这个计划是否有纰漏。”

“万一红红最后没有吃到羊，那不太可惜了吗？”

芮娜娜耸了耸肩，故作镇定。

懒羊羊突然有些隐忧，莫非灰太狼真的是假的？

昨天那些，只不过是碰巧撞上了？

“灰太狼大叔。”

“你这个计划里，最重要的一点，不是美羊羊。”

懒羊羊弯下了腰，在床下摸索着什么。

芮娜娜笑道：

“不是美羊羊，也不会是沸羊羊吧？”

懒羊羊哈哈一笑，手继续摸索着。

Page (1/3)

The sky of Koala Kingdom.

Rui Nana, the chosen one of Koala Kingdom, has arrived in Yangcun.

Although she copied Long Guo's homework in the early stage, unlike Lin Yuan, she did not wait for Nuan Yangyang with Boiling Yangyang.

After arriving at Yangcun, Rui Nana visited Lazy Yangyang.

Originally, she thought that Lazy Yangyang saved her yesterday, so why would she tell her something about the strange story game today?

Unexpectedly, when she arrived at Lazy Yangyang's house, the latter didn't want to see her at all.

"Uncle Big Wolf, what do you want to do when you come to my house?"

Lazy Sheep's tone was as plain as seeing a kangaroo on the roadside in their country.

Rui Nana adjusted her tone and told everything about the encounter with Boiling Yangyang.

After listening to this, Lazy Yangyang stretched his waist.

"Uncle Big Big Wolf, you want to ask me if there will be any problems if I take him back like this, right?"

Rui Nana didn't expect Lazy Sheep to be so smart.

Today's prompt opportunities have been used up, and the three choices are also used in the midnight sheepfold.

So...the only thing she can think of is to close the distance with Weird like Lin Yuan.

In fact, if possible, she planned to ask Red Wolf.

It's just that Boiling Yangyang was busy at that time and she didn't have time.

The next best thing is to look for lazy sheep.

Rui Nana nodded:

"Yeah, Lazy Sheep, I always think there's something wrong with that."

"You said let them take a bath face to face, will Meiyangyang..."

Rui Nana suddenly thought that Lazy Yangyang and the others didn't seem to know that they could become strange.

Without thinking, Lazy Yangyang said directly:

"You mean, if Meiyangyang finds out, will he kill you?"

Rui Nana spread her hands:

"Okay, that's what I mean."

The laziness on Lazy Yangyang's face gradually faded away, and a smile appeared on his face:

"Uncle Big Big Wolf, why are you still afraid of our lamb's revenge? You were...not like this yesterday."

Rui Nana's expression was a little stiff, but she soon returned to normal.

"Hey, Lazy Sheep, I was just teasing you."

"I'm not afraid of boiling sheep, how can I be afraid of beautiful sheep?"

"Besides...they've all arrived at my house, how can I let them escape?"

Lazy Yangyang looked at Rui Nana doubtfully, feeling uncertain in her heart.

"I came to your house because I want you to help me see if there are any flaws in this plan."

"Wouldn't it be a pity if Honghong didn't eat the sheep in the end?"

Ruinana shrugged, pretending to be calm.

Lazy Sheep suddenly felt worried. Could it be that Big Big Wolf was really a fake?

Did those yesterday just happen to happen?

"Uncle Big Big Wolf."

"The most important thing in your plan is not Meiyangyang."

Lazy Yangyang bent down and groped for something under the bed.

Rui Nana smiled and said:

"It's not a beautiful sheep, nor is it a boiling sheep?"

Lazy Yangyang laughed and continued to fumble with his hands.
